title: Remove the owner-merges label so agents merge every story on green
summary: The owner-merges label is gone from orion's rules, skills, PRD and guide, and from the GitHub repository, so /dev-next merges every story it builds on green checks. A suite check fails if the label comes back.

deferred.what: The PRD says a mod is checked by hand with claude plugin validate, claude plugin test and tsc; with owner-merges gone nobody runs them before an agent merges a mods/ change on green CI, which runs none of the three.
deferred.why: Whether the dev agent's gate runs them is a gate decision outside this issue's seam.
